items.name: FileGroup
items.summary: Represents a group of partitioned files that'll be processed by a single thread. Maintains optional statistics across all files in the group.

methods.name: file_statistics
methods.summary: Get the specific file statistics for the given index If the index is None, return the `FileGroup` statistics

methods.name: files
methods.summary: Returns a slice of the files in this group

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = PartitionedFile>>(iter: I) -> Self

methods.name: group_by_partition_values
methods.summary: Groups files by their partition values, ensuring all files with same partition values are in the same group.

methods.name: index_mut
methods.signature: fn index_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut Self::Output

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of files in this group

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new FileGroup from a vector of PartitionedFile objects

methods.name: pop
methods.summary: Removes the last element from the files vector and returns it, or None if empty

methods.name: push
methods.summary: Adds a file to the group

methods.name: split_files
methods.summary: Partition the list of files into `n` groups

methods.name: statistics_mut
methods.summary: Get the mutable reference to the statistics for this group

methods.name: with_statistics
methods.summary: Set the statistics for this group

items.name: FileGroupPartitioner
items.summary: Repartition input files into `target_partitions` partitions, if total file size exceed `repartition_file_min_size`

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new [`FileGroupPartitioner`] with default values: 1. `target_partitions = 1` 2. `repartition_file_min_size = 10MB` 3. `preserve_order_within_groups = false`

methods.name: repartition_file_groups
methods.summary: Repartition input files according to the settings on this [`FileGroupPartitioner`].

methods.name: with_preserve_order_within_groups
methods.summary: Set whether the order of tuples within a file must be preserved

methods.name: with_repartition_file_min_size
methods.summary: Set the minimum size at which to repartition a file
